title: Snipped Vines
description: Helps differentiate snipped and unsnipped vines and kelp
body:
![Snipped Vines](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ca2dd575c7abec12ed81e5b9e5dbf6c7f975800.png)
#
A lightweight resource pack for telling the difference between snipped and growing vines and kelp. Never worry about your decorations getting too long!
Works for:
- Cave Vines (glow berry vines)
- Weeping Vines (crimson vines)
- Twisting Vines (warped vines)
- Kelp
